sections.text_helper: Section 68.5 "SAI interrupts" in chapter 68 (Serial audio interface (SAI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3538.
sections.section_content:
The SAI supports 7 interrupt sources, as shown in Table679.
[Table 679. SAI interrupt sources]
Follow the sequence below to enable an interrupt:
1. Disable SAI interrupt.
2. Configure SAI.
3. Configure SAI interrupt source.
4. Enable SAI.
